editor_note: The meaning is faithful all the way through. The data-encoding caveat ("poate fi costisitoare de implementat"), the ripple-carry example (A=2, B=3, result written to B's register) and the quantity claims about quantum volume all match the English. The problem is the word for "gate", which appears in three forms: "Gate-uri", "poartă"/"poartă multi-controlled-X", and the made-up plural "poartă-uri". "poartă-uri" is not a Romanian word and shows up in [15], [17] and [37]. Smaller calques include "necesită construire din" in [10], and "shots" is rendered as "rulări" in [43].

examples.source: layers of single-qubit rotation gates with layers of multi-qubit entangling gates
examples.translation: straturi de poartă-uri de rotație cu un singur qubit cu straturi de poartă-uri de entanglement
examples.suggested: straturi de porți de rotație pe un singur qubit cu straturi de porți de entanglement pe mai mulți qubiți
examples.why: 'poartă-uri' is not a real Romanian plural. It mixes the Romanian noun with the English-style '-uri' ending, and the same word appears as 'Gate-uri' and 'poarta' elsewhere in the file.

examples.source: multi-qubit gates that usually need building from single- and two-qubit gates ... the first argument is the gate
examples.translation: care de obicei necesită construire din Gate-uri cu unul sau doi Qubiți ... primul argument este poarta
examples.suggested: care de obicei trebuie construite din porți pe unul sau doi qubiți ... primul argument este poarta
examples.why: 'necesită construire' is a stiff calque, and the same sentence switches from 'Gate-uri' to 'poarta'.

examples.source: outputs `5` for all `1024` shots
examples.translation: produce `5` pentru toate cele `1024` de rulări
examples.suggested: produce `5` în toate cele `1024` de shot-uri (măsurători)
examples.why: 'rulări' can be understood but is ambiguous: it can also mean runs of a whole job. Shots are usually kept as 'shot-uri' or glossed as repeated measurements.

editor_note: The meaning is faithful throughout. Every caveat survives: the account will not be activated without the final step, you should not enter credit card details, you must create a new account even if you already have a personal IBM Cloud one, and students see only their own instance. "Feature code" is rendered consistently as "cod de activare (feature code)", and informal "tu" holds throughout. There are two small wording slips a native editor would fix. "Planul Open Plan" is redundant because it says "plan" twice. In entry 22, "aceștia vor procesa" is plural, but it refers back to the singular noun "echipa", so it should read "aceasta va procesa".

examples.source: under the Open Plan ... The Open Plan provides 10 minutes
examples.translation: sub planul Open Plan ... Planul Open Plan oferă 10 minute
examples.suggested: în cadrul planului Open ... Planul Open oferă 10 minute
examples.why: This says "plan" twice ("plan Open Plan"). A native writer would drop one of them.

examples.source: send this ID number to the IBM Quantum team, and they will process
examples.translation: către echipa IBM Quantum, iar aceștia vor procesa contul
examples.suggested: către echipa IBM Quantum, care va procesa contul
examples.why: The English uses plural "they" for the team, and the translation copies it. In Romanian the pronoun should match the singular noun "echipa".

editor_note: The meaning is faithful all the way through. The phase-disk, reduced-purity, q-sphere and gate-glossary sections keep every condition, quantity and caveat, so nothing here would mislead a learner. What a native editor would still fix: 'superposition' is misspelled 'superpozițe' in [229], [243], [247] and most of the repeated q-sphere table notes, and [243] has a grammar error ('dacă qubitului se află'). Terms are also split within the file. Entanglement is 'intricare/intricat' in [145]/[147] but English 'entanglement' in [182]. The plural of qubit alternates between 'qubiți' and 'qubit-urilor'. Statevector is 'vectorul de stare' in [8] but left as 'statevector' later on, and single-shot is 'cu o singură execuție' in [25] but 'cu un singur shot' in [121]. A few passages are stiff or calqued: [150] 'reprezintă o reprezentare incompletă', [145] 'Pentru a reprezenta că informația completă…', [122] 'Vizualizează vizualizările', and the dangling gerund in [264].

examples.source: creates an equal superposition state if the qubit is in the state $|0\rangle$
examples.translation: creează o stare de superpozițe egală dacă qubitului se află în starea $|0\rangle$
examples.suggested: creează o stare de superpoziție egală dacă qubitul se află în starea $|0\rangle$
examples.why: There are two errors in one sentence: the misspelling 'superpozițe', which recurs in [229], [247] and the table notes, and the dative 'qubitului' used where the sentence needs the subject form 'qubitul'.

examples.source: If the control qubit is in a superposition, this gate creates entanglement.
examples.translation: Dacă qubit-ul de control se află în superpoziție, această poartă creează entanglement.
examples.suggested: Dacă qubitul de control se află în superpoziție, această poartă creează intricare.
examples.why: Earlier in the file ([145], [147]) the page uses the Romanian term 'intricare/intricat'. This sentence switches to the English 'entanglement', and it also uses 'qubit-ul' instead of 'qubitul'.

examples.source: In this view the quantum phases are not represented, and is therefore an incomplete representation.
examples.translation: În această vizualizare, fazele cuantice nu sunt reprezentate și, prin urmare, reprezintă o reprezentare incompletă.
examples.suggested: Această vizualizare nu redă fazele cuantice, deci este o reprezentare incompletă.
examples.why: 'reprezintă o reprezentare' is a redundant construction that follows the English syntax too closely.

examples.source: To represent that full information is not contained in this visualization, we introduce the reduced purity
examples.translation: Pentru a reprezenta că informația completă nu este conținută în această vizualizare, introducem puritatea redusă
examples.suggested: Pentru a indica faptul că această vizualizare nu conține informația completă, introducem puritatea redusă
examples.why: 'a reprezenta că' is a calque from English. A native writer would say 'a indica faptul că'.

examples.source: a single-shot statevector simulator
examples.translation: un simulator statevector cu un singur shot
examples.suggested: un simulator al vectorului de stare cu o singură execuție (as in [25])
examples.why: [25] renders the same phrase as 'simulator al vectorului de stare cu o singură execuție'. The two renderings of one concept are inconsistent.

examples.source: swapping the two qubits it acts on doesn't change anything.
examples.translation: schimbând cei doi qubiți pe care acționează nu se modifică nimic.
examples.suggested: interschimbarea celor doi qubiți asupra cărora acționează nu schimbă nimic.
examples.why: The dangling gerund is an unidiomatic calque of the English -ing clause.

editor_note: The meaning is faithful all the way through. The open-source caveats in [12], the Open Plan restriction on sessions in [8] and the plan list in [28] all survive intact. The problems are small grammar and calque slips. In [14], "Conceput" does not agree with its feminine subject "platforma". In [15], "integra platforma în mod fluent" is a calque of "seamlessly", and "Odată configurat" has no clear subject. In [25], "observable" becomes the masculine "observabilii ... doriți" instead of the usual feminine "observabilele". [12] uses the English-style gerund "Qiskit SDK rulând pe server". [18] has stiff calques such as "necesită o varietate de cerințe de resurse" and "supercomputing centrat pe cuantic".

examples.source: Designed to support teams ... the platform centralizes access
examples.translation: Conceput pentru a sprijini echipe ... platforma centralizează accesul
examples.suggested: Concepută pentru a sprijini echipe ..., platforma centralizează accesul
examples.why: The participle does not agree in gender with the feminine noun 'platforma'.

examples.source: integrate the platform seamlessly into their development workflows
examples.translation: integra platforma în mod fluent în fluxurile lor de lucru
examples.suggested: integra platforma fără efort în fluxurile lor de dezvoltare
examples.why: 'În mod fluent' is a calque and not the idiomatic rendering of 'seamlessly'. 'Odată configurat' in the same sentence also has no clear subject.

examples.source: desired measurement observables as input
examples.translation: observabilii de măsurare doriți ca intrare
examples.suggested: observabilele de măsurat dorite ca date de intrare
examples.why: 'Observable' is normally the feminine noun 'observabilă' (plural 'observabile') in Romanian, so the masculine form is nonstandard.

examples.source: quantum-centric supercomputing use cases
examples.translation: cazuri de utilizare multi-cloud și supercomputing centrat pe cuantic
examples.suggested: scenarii multi-cloud și de supercalcul centrat pe calculul cuantic
examples.why: 'Centrat pe cuantic' is an awkward calque, and the adjective has no noun to modify.

examples.source: the Qiskit SDK running on the server side
examples.translation: Qiskit SDK rulând pe server
examples.suggested: Qiskit SDK care rulează pe server
examples.why: Using the gerund as a relative clause copies English syntax; Romanian prefers 'care rulează'.

editor_note: The meaning is faithful throughout. Defaults, overrides, caveats and conditions all match the English, including the QISKIT_FORCE_THREADS serial-fallback explanation and the SABRE reproducibility tradeoff. Two small phrasing issues: in [24], "random trials" became "teste aleatorii", which reads like software tests when "încercări aleatorii" is meant. In [22], "setează aceasta la o valoare întreagă" is a stiff calque of "set this to an integer value".

examples.source: this uses all available CPUs for running multiple random trials
examples.translation: acesta folosește toate CPU-urile disponibile pentru a rula mai multe teste aleatorii
examples.suggested: folosește toate CPU-urile disponibile pentru a rula mai multe încercări aleatorii
examples.why: 'teste' suggests software tests. SABRE runs multiple randomized layout/routing attempts, which 'încercări' conveys correctly.

examples.source: To adjust the number of threads Qiskit uses, set this to an integer value.
examples.translation: Pentru a ajusta numărul de fire pe care Qiskit le folosește, setează aceasta la o valoare întreagă.
examples.suggested: Pentru a ajusta numărul de fire folosite de Qiskit, setează variabila la o valoare întreagă.
examples.why: The bare 'aceasta' used as the object is calqued from 'this'. Naming the variable reads more naturally in Romanian.

editor_note: The meaning is faithful all the way through. The conditions, the "at most 3 qubits" limit, the None-return caveat and the reserved `supports_` rule all come across correctly, so nothing here would mislead a learner. The problems are small consistency and markup slips. The link text "Transpiler plugins" is left in English in [57], but [29] and [43] translate it as "Plugin-uri Transpiler". "Property methods" is "metode de tip proprietate" in [34] but "metode de proprietate" in [50]. In [58] the two tip-list lines picked up a 4-space indent the English does not have, which MDX may render as a code block. The phrase "manager de pași stadializat prestabilit" in [7] is also stiff.

examples.source: follow the instructions at [Transpiler plugins](transpiler-plugins#...)
examples.translation: urmează instrucțiunile de la [Transpiler plugins](...)
examples.suggested: urmează instrucțiunile de la [Plugin-uri Transpiler](...)
examples.why: Entries [29] and [43] translate the same link text. Here it was left in English.

examples.source: a number of property methods that need to be defined
examples.translation: există o serie de metode de proprietate care trebuie definite
examples.suggested: există o serie de metode de tip proprietate care trebuie definite
examples.why: [34] renders the identical sentence as "metode de tip proprietate". "Metode de proprietate" is also less clear.

examples.source: - [Submit your plugin to the Qiskit Ecosystem!](...)
examples.translation: - [Trimite plugin-ul tău în Ecosistemul Qiskit!](...)
examples.suggested: - [Trimite plugin-ul tău în Ecosistemul Qiskit!](...)
examples.why: The English list items have no indent. The added 4-space indent inside the Admonition may make MDX render them as a code block instead of a list.

examples.source: one of the 6 stages of a preset staged pass manager
examples.translation: una dintre cele 6 etape ale unui manager de pași stadializat prestabilit
examples.suggested: una dintre cele 6 etape ale unui manager de pași prestabilit, organizat pe etape
examples.why: "Stadializat" is a stiff calque of "staged". Saying "organizat pe etape" reads more naturally.

editor_note: The meaning is faithful throughout and nothing would mislead a learner. The CZ-within-chip / CX-between-chip setup, the arrow-direction explanation and the SWAP overhead all match the English. The plural of backend is inconsistent: headings [21] and [25] leave the raw English plural "backends", while the rest of the file uses "Backend-uri". Circuit also appears in three forms ("Circuit-uri", "circuit-uri", "circuite"), and transpiler in two ("Transpiler-ului", "Transpilerului"). In [8], "rețea de Qubiți disjuncți" makes the qubits disjoint instead of the lattice, and [7] has the calques "a suporta configurații" and "Acest subiect demonstrează".

examples.source: a backend with a disjoint qubit lattice
examples.translation: un Backend cu o rețea de Qubiți disjuncți
examples.suggested: un Backend cu o rețea disjunctă de qubiți
examples.why: In English the lattice is disjoint (separate chips). The Romanian says the qubits are disjoint, which is a slightly different and vaguer idea.

examples.source: Visualize backends
examples.translation: Vizualizează backends
examples.suggested: Vizualizează Backend-uri
examples.why: This keeps the raw English plural, while the rest of the file (and the link text in [30]) uses "Backend-uri". [25] has the same problem: "Transpilare față de backends personalizate".

examples.source: the ability to support unique device configurations ... This topic demonstrates
examples.translation: capacitatea de a suporta configurații unice de dispozitive ... Acest subiect demonstrează
examples.suggested: capacitatea de a oferi suport pentru configurații unice de dispozitive ... Acest ghid arată
examples.why: "a suporta" (for support) and "subiect" (for a docs topic) are calques from English. A native technical writer would use "a oferi suport pentru" and "ghid" or "pagină".

examples.source: the number of circuits a backend can execute
examples.translation: numărul de circuit-uri pe care un Backend le poate executa
examples.suggested: numărul de circuite pe care un Backend le poate executa
examples.why: Circuit shows up as "Circuit-uri" in [0]/[7], "circuit-uri" here and "circuite" in [26]. The file should pick one plural and use it everywhere.

editor_note: The meaning holds throughout. The 90%/80% PEA/ZNE thresholds, the caution that the Aer noise model is likely less severe than real QPU noise, and the smallest-difference rule all match the English. The remaining problems are wording. 'Transpiler pass' is 'pas' in [18] but 'pass managers' becomes 'manageri de trecere' in [40], so the same concept gets two words. 'Figures of merit' is calqued as 'figuri de merit' in [24] and [28], 'wrapper în jurul' in [18] is a literal calque, and [40] drops 'available' from 'available IBM Quantum Compute options'.

examples.source: Visit the [Transpile with pass managers] topic.
examples.translation: Vizitează subiectul [Transpilare cu manageri de trecere].
examples.suggested: Vizitează subiectul [Transpilare cu manageri de pași].
examples.why: 'Pass' is rendered 'pas' in [18] (pasului Transpiler). 'Trecere' is a literal rendering that doesn't match that and isn't the usual term.

examples.source: uses the absolute difference as a figure of merit
examples.translation: folosește diferența absolută ca figură de merit
examples.suggested: folosește diferența absolută ca indicator de performanță (metrică de calitate)
examples.why: 'Figură de merit' is a calque. Romanian technical prose normally says 'cifră de merit' or 'indicator de performanță'.

examples.source: is a wrapper around the ConvertISAToClifford transpiler pass
examples.translation: este un wrapper în jurul pasului Transpiler
examples.suggested: este un wrapper pentru pasul de transpilare ConvertISAToClifford
examples.why: 'În jurul' copies the English 'around' word for word and reads stiffly.

examples.source: Learn about [available IBM Quantum Compute options]
examples.translation: Învață despre [opțiunile IBM Quantum Compute]
examples.suggested: Învață despre [opțiunile IBM Quantum Compute disponibile]
examples.why: The translation drops the qualifier 'available'. This does not change the meaning much.

editor_note: The meaning is faithful throughout. The override rules in [22] and [29], the approximation_degree scale in [39] and the defaults (sabre, translator, alap) all match the English. In [43], "ground state" is rendered as "starea de bază". The standard Romanian term is "starea fundamentală", and "stare de bază" is easily confused with a computational basis state. Some phrasing is stiff: "O țintă Transpiler de Backend" in [22], the calque "Planifică instrucțiunile lacom" in [42], and the [1] title, which shifts "Transpilation" to "Transpiler-ului".

examples.source: keeping qubits in the ground state when possible
examples.translation: menținând qubiții în starea de bază când este posibil
examples.suggested: menținând qubiții în starea fundamentală cât mai mult posibil
examples.why: The conventional Romanian term for ground state is 'starea fundamentală'. 'Starea de bază' is ambiguous with basis state.

examples.source: `target` (Target) - A backend transpiler target.
examples.translation: O țintă Transpiler de Backend.
examples.suggested: Ținta de transpilare a backend-ului.
examples.why: This is a noun-stack calque that reads as machine translation.

examples.source: Schedule instructions greedily, as early as possible
examples.translation: Planifică instrucțiunile lacom, cât mai devreme posibil
examples.suggested: Planifică instrucțiunile după o strategie greedy, cât mai devreme posibil
examples.why: 'Lacom' as an adverb is a literal calque of 'greedily'. Romanian technical writing usually says 'greedy' or 'după o strategie greedy'.

examples.source: Transpilation default settings and configuration options
examples.translation: Setările implicite ale Transpiler-ului și opțiunile de configurare
examples.suggested: Setări implicite și opțiuni de configurare pentru transpilare
examples.why: The title changes 'transpilation' to 'transpiler'. This is minor, but it is not what the heading says.

editor_note: The translation keeps the meaning. The conditions in [30] (Pauli-Lindblad for one- and two-qubit gates, TREX for measurements) and the client/server split in [4] both match the English, and the core terms are consistent: "reducerea erorilor", "Circuit șablon", "samplex" and "valorile medii". A native editor would still fix three small things. In [20], "a raționa despre colecții de operații" is a calque of "reason about". In [29], "current" is dropped from "the current NoiseLearner", which loses the hint that V3 sits beside an existing tool. In [22], "exact" is added ("îi spun ... exact ce parametri"), a slight strengthening that is not in the English.

examples.source: uses the box construct to reason about collections of circuit operations
examples.translation: Folosește construcția box pentru a raționa despre colecții de operații de circuit
examples.suggested: Folosește construcția box pentru a descrie și gestiona grupuri de operații de circuit
examples.why: 'a raționa despre' is a literal calque of 'reason about'. A Romanian technical writer would not phrase it that way.

examples.source: Similar to the current NoiseLearner
examples.translation: Similar cu NoiseLearner
examples.suggested: Similar cu actualul NoiseLearner
examples.why: Dropping 'current' loses the point that NoiseLearner is the existing tool and V3 is its successor. Minor, but the qualifier carries context.

examples.source: tell the Executor primitive what parameters to generate
examples.translation: îi spun primitivei Executor exact ce parametri să genereze
examples.suggested: îi spun primitivei Executor ce parametri să genereze
examples.why: 'exact' is added and slightly strengthens the claim. It does not mislead, but the English does not say it.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout. The explanations of why YGate is added to the target and why BasisTranslator has to run again both survive intact. There are three surface problems. Entry [17] uses "espaciată", a Spanish-looking non-word, where Romanian needs "spațiată" (entry [16] spells it correctly). Entry [19] has a gender-agreement error, "un poartă de bază real al Backend-ului", which should read "o poartă de bază reală a". Finally, "timing" is rendered as "sincronizare" throughout; "temporizare" or "informații de timp" would be more accurate, because "sincronizare" means synchronization.

examples.source: a regularly-spaced sequence of `XGate` objects and `YGate` objects
examples.translation: o secvență espaciată regulat de obiecte `XGate` și `YGate`
examples.suggested: o secvență spațiată regulat de obiecte `XGate` și `YGate`
examples.why: 'espaciată' is not Romanian (it looks like a Spanish calque). Entry [16] already uses the correct 'spațiate'.

examples.source: because the `YGate` is not an actual basis gate of our backend
examples.translation: deoarece `YGate` nu este un poartă de bază real al Backend-ului nostru
examples.suggested: deoarece `YGate` nu este o poartă de bază reală a Backend-ului nostru
examples.why: 'poartă' is feminine, so the article and adjective must agree with it. 'un ... real al' is ungrammatical.

examples.source: add timing information for the gates
examples.translation: a adăuga informații de sincronizare pentru Gate-urile
examples.suggested: a adăuga informații de temporizare pentru porțile
examples.why: 'sincronizare' means synchronization, not timing or duration. 'temporizare' is closer. The same choice recurs in [14], [16], [17] and [21].

editor_note: The meaning is faithful throughout: the PEC max_overhead caveat, the ZNE and PEC bias claims, and the γ scaling all survive, so nothing here would mislead a learner. "Twirling" is split between the kept loanword ("twirling-ul Pauli", "măsurători cu twirling") and a literal calque ("răsuciri Pauli", "Circuite răsucite"). The split even shows up between the TREX heading [28] ("prin răsucire") and the body text [29] ("prin twirling"). "Unbiased" is also rendered two ways: "nedeformat" in [39] and "nedeplasată (fără bias)" in [64]. There are also some calques and slips: "sandwicharea" in [19], a gender-agreement error "Efectuată singură" for the neuter "twirling-ul" in [18], and "cantitatea" for the math sense of "quantity" in [67].

examples.source: The following diagram depicts some Pauli twirls for the CNOT and ECR gates.
examples.translation: Diagrama următoare ilustrează câteva răsuciri Pauli pentru Gate-urile CNOT și ECR.
examples.suggested: Diagrama următoare ilustrează câteva twirl-uri Pauli pentru porțile CNOT și ECR.
examples.why: The rest of the file keeps 'twirling' as a loanword, so the literal 'răsuciri' (and 'Circuite răsucite' in [24], 'prin răsucire' in [28]) breaks consistency.

examples.source: it is not guaranteed to produce an unbiased result.
examples.translation: nu garantează producerea unui rezultat nedeformat.
examples.suggested: nu garantează un rezultat nedeplasat (fără bias).
examples.why: 'Nedeformat' is not the statistical term, and [64] renders the same concept as 'nedeplasată (fără bias)'.

examples.source: Performed alone, it can mitigate coherent noise
examples.translation: Efectuată singură, poate atenua zgomotul coerent
examples.suggested: Aplicat singur, poate atenua zgomotul coerent
examples.why: The participle is feminine but the subject 'twirling-ul' is neuter.

examples.source: implemented by sandwiching a chosen set of gates with randomly chosen single-qubit Pauli gates
examples.translation: implementat prin sandwicharea unui set ales de porți cu Gate-uri Pauli cu un singur qubit alese aleatoriu
examples.suggested: implementat prin încadrarea unui set ales de porți între porți Pauli cu un singur qubit, alese aleatoriu
examples.why: 'Sandwicharea' is an awkward calque that a native technical writer would avoid.

examples.source: which is characterized by the quantity
examples.translation: care este caracterizat de cantitatea
examples.suggested: care este caracterizat de mărimea
examples.why: In a math or physics context, 'quantity' means 'mărime', not 'cantitate'.

editor_note: The meaning is faithful throughout. The precision precedence order ([30]-[35]), the twirling shot-allocation failure caveat ([36]) and the inverse precision/QPU-time note ([37]) all match the English, so nothing here would mislead a learner. The register slips into the formal form in two places: [6] uses "Puteți… Consultați" and [28] uses "Rețineți", while the rest of the page uses informal "tu". A few calques should be fixed: "rezultatele nu sunt garantate să atingă" ([27]) and the ungrammatical "ceea ce implică fără constrângeri" ([139]). Also, "Choices" is rendered as "Opțiuni", which clashes with "opțiuni" (options), the main subject of the page.

examples.source: You can use options to customize the Estimator primitive... Consult the API references
examples.translation: Puteți folosi opțiunile pentru a personaliza primitivul Estimator... Consultați referințele API
examples.suggested: Poți folosi opțiunile pentru a personaliza primitivul Estimator... Consultă referințele API
examples.why: This uses the formal plural, while the rest of the page uses informal 'tu' (e.g. 'Poți seta', 'Folosește'). Entry [28] has the same problem with 'Rețineți'.

examples.source: the results are not guaranteed to reach the specified precision
examples.translation: iar rezultatele nu sunt garantate să atingă precizia specificată
examples.suggested: iar nu este garantat că rezultatele vor atinge precizia specificată
examples.why: This is a calque of the English passive. It is not idiomatic in Romanian.

examples.source: None, which implies no connectivity constraints (full connectivity).
examples.translation: None, ceea ce implică fără constrângeri de conectivitate (conectivitate completă).
examples.suggested: None, ceea ce înseamnă că nu există constrângeri de conectivitate (conectivitate completă).
examples.why: 'implică fără constrângeri' is ungrammatical: the verb needs a clause or noun phrase after it.

examples.source: **Choices**: Integer >= 0
examples.translation: **Opțiuni**: Număr întreg >= 0
examples.suggested: **Valori posibile**: Număr întreg >= 0
examples.why: On a page about Estimator 'opțiuni' (options), using the same word for a field's allowed values is confusing. 'Valori posibile' keeps the two ideas separate.

examples.source: [Qiskit Aer NoiseModel](/guides/build-noise-models), or its representation
examples.translation: [Model de zgomot Qiskit Aer NoiseModel](/guides/build-noise-models) sau reprezentarea sa
examples.suggested: [NoiseModel din Qiskit Aer](/guides/build-noise-models) sau reprezentarea sa
examples.why: This is redundant: it translates the class name and also keeps it, so it says 'noise model' twice.

editor_note: The meaning holds throughout. The fair-share logic, the 28-day rolling window, the Flex Plan caveat and FIFO within an instance are all rendered faithfully. The problem is the countable term "workload(s)", which switches between "sarcină/sarcini de lucru" ([3], [14], [16]) and "volum/volume de lucru" ([0], [10], [11]). "Volum de lucru" is a mass noun meaning "amount of work", so "de două ori mai multe volume de lucru" in [11] reads awkwardly. Use "sarcini de lucru" consistently for discrete jobs and keep "volumul de lucru" only for the aggregate sense in [3].

editor_note: The meaning is faithful throughout. In [10] the sentence makes the gates ("ele ... trebuie încărcate") the thing loaded with `use_fractional_gates`, but the English means the QPU/backend. Two phrasings are stiff: "timpul de gate al gate-urilor" in [13] and "Acest lucru necesită să ai mai multă grijă" in [31]. editor_note: The meaning is faithful throughout. The caveats on batching and job limits (per job rather than per PUB, the 6073 remedy, and estimator_options replacing the defaults wholesale) are all kept, and I found no drift or hallucination. Three small wording problems remain. "Keyword arguments" is rendered as "Argumente cheie", which reads as "key/main arguments". The Hamiltonian is a feminine noun in some places ("hamiltoniană Pauli", entries 5 and 39) and masculine/neuter "hamiltonianului" in entry 38. The headings "Exemplu de hardware" / "Exemplu de simulator" and the phrase "atenuarea de eroare" are stiff calques.

editor_note: I found nothing that would mislead a learner. The meaning holds throughout, including the capacity checks in run() (entry 34), the empty-list caveat for runtime jobs (entry 57), and the include/exclude filters in filtered_logs (entry 60). Terms are used consistently and the informal "tu" holds everywhere (job→job, transpilation→transpilare, error mitigation→atenuarea erorilor, observable backpropagation→retropropagarea observabilelor). Two phrases are calqued from the English: the page title "Începe cu Qiskit Functions" reads like a literal "Get started", where a Romanian writer would use "Primii pași cu Qiskit Functions". In the description, "sarcini comune" copies "common tasks"; "sarcini uzuale" is more natural.

examples.source: Get started with Qiskit Functions
examples.translation: Începe cu Qiskit Functions
examples.suggested: Primii pași cu Qiskit Functions

examples.suggested: Cum să realizezi sarcinile uzuale

editor_note: The meaning holds throughout, including the long table rows. The "respectively" contrast in HI-VQE is kept, and so are "unbiased" (nedeplasate) and "zero-overhead". editor_note: The meaning is faithful all the way through. "Expectation value" is calqued as "valoare de așteptare" in [3], [13] and [25], where Romanian physics normally uses "valoarea așteptată" or "valoarea medie". editor_note: The meaning is faithful throughout. editor_note: The meaning is faithful all the way through. The claims, card descriptions and the ecosystem and Functions caveats all match the English, and the informal "tu" register holds (Construiește, Explorează, Caută). A native editor would still fix a few calqued phrases. The Quickstart card's "fără autentificare sau cheie API necesară" copies the English word order and should read "nu necesită autentificare sau cheie API". "Obține ajutor" is a literal copy of "Get help", and "Folosește primitive IBM Quantum" is missing the definite article ("primitivele IBM Quantum").

editor_note: The meaning is faithful throughout. The limited/unlimited Flex and Premium behaviour, the archive rules and the region caveats all match the English. The problems are small. "count toward your plan's allotted time" is calqued as "contează pentru timpul alocat" in [8] and [19]/[24], where "se scade din" would be natural. [34] "Not passing in an instance" becomes "Neutilizarea unei instanțe", which shifts the sense from "not passing" to "not using". "workloads" is "volume de lucru" everywhere except the [58] admonition title, which says "Lucrări în așteptare". "Flex Plan"/"Premium Plan" are left in English word order in [20]/[25], while the rest of the file uses "Planul Flex".

examples.suggested: (sau se scad din timpul alocat planului tău)

examples.suggested: Netransmiterea unei instanțe la inițializare

editor_note: The meaning is faithful throughout. I found no drift in the tricky passages: the parse-error condition in [29], the builtin semantics in [30] and [38], and the strict-mode caveat in [51] all match the source. The problems are phrasing only. "Legacy" is calqued as an uninflected noun used like an adjective ("exportatorul moștenire", "versiunile moștenire", "comportament moștenire", "Gate-urile moștenire"), where natural Romanian would say "exportatorul vechi (legacy)" or "comportament moștenit". "Quality-of-life improvements" is rendered literally as "îmbunătățiri de calitate a vieții". Separately from the leak sweep, the lowercase native term also switches between "poartă/porți" ([21], [34], [36]–[38]) and the kept "Gate-uri" in the same paragraphs.

examples.source: working with the legacy exporter
examples.translation: exemplul specific de lucru cu exportatorul moștenire
examples.suggested: exemplul specific de lucru cu exportatorul vechi (legacy)
examples.why: 'moștenire' is a noun and cannot follow another noun as an uninflected adjective. This calque repeats in [23], [31], [33] and [55]. Use 'moștenit/vechi' or keep 'legacy'.

examples.source: several other quality-of-life improvements
examples.translation: mai multe alte îmbunătățiri de calitate a vieții
examples.suggested: alte câteva facilități de comoditate
examples.why: This is a literal calque of an English idiom. A Romanian technical writer would not describe parser leniency as 'calitate a vieții'.

examples.source: Qiskit chooses a custom gate using the precise definition supplied
examples.translation: Qiskit alege o poartă personalizată ... Gate-urile standard integrate ... Gate personalizat
examples.suggested: Use one rendering for 'gate' throughout (poartă/porți)
examples.why: 'Gate' is rendered as 'poartă' and as 'Gate' within the same paragraph and elsewhere in the file ([21], [34]). This is inconsistent terminology, though the concept stays clear.

editor_note: The meaning is faithful all the way through. The four steps, ISA/basis gates, Batch vs Session, and the Sampler bitstrings vs Estimator expectation values contrast all read correctly, and the "tu" register holds. A native editor would still smooth a few calques. "physical quantities" became "cantităților fizice" where the standard term is "mărimilor fizice". "utility-scale" became the literal "la scară utilitară". "dezirabil" and "inferarea" are anglicisms. [21] also adds "manuală", which is not in the source.

examples.suggested: poate fi de asemenea util să specifici ... estimarea (deducerea) funcțiilor de corelație

editor_note: Faithful and natural, with every caveat kept: "all options except shots are ignored" becomes "toate opțiunile cu excepția shots sunt ignorate", the noise-model caution keeps "mai puțin sever decât zgomotul de pe un QPU real", and terms stay consistent (fake backends→Backend-uri false, density matrix→matricea de densitate).

The translation is faithful and reads naturally, with consistent informal "tu" throughout. Key renderings are sound: "furnizor extern de identitate (IDP)", "autentificarea unică (SSO)" and "reguli dinamice … fără să adaugi manual fiecare utilizator", and the "(poate implica un cost)" caveat is kept.

The meaning holds throughout, including the beta caveats, the no-simulator note, the Estimator exclusion and the twirling-undo steps, so nothing here would mislead a learner. The main problem is that "twirling" has no single rendering in the file. It appears as "răsucire" in entries [8]–[57], then switches to "twirling-ul" or "twirled" in [89], [93]–[95] and [92], and [93] even mixes both as "răsucirea (twirling) … (twirled)". There are also smaller inconsistencies ("shots" vs "rulările (shots)", "sampling" in [97] vs "eșantionare" elsewhere) and a few calques: "Cartografiere conceptuală" for "Conceptual mapping", and "locul unde trăiesc setările" for "where settings live".

examples.suggested: Există și o diferență structurală privind locul în care se configurează setările.

editor_note: The meaning is faithful throughout. The migration tables, PEA/PEC noise-learning caveats, the job-splitting example and the Cliffordization consequences all match the English, and none of them would mislead a learner. There are a few polish issues. [56] renders "Parameters are bound away" as "Parametrii sunt legați", which drops the sense that the parameters are removed. [55] has the typo "Clifordizat", while [52] spells it "Cliffordizează". A few phrases are calques: "diferențe de comportament de înțeles" [3], "interfețe primitive" [5], which reads as "crude interfaces", and "simulare stabilizator" [53].

examples.translation: **Parametrii sunt legați.**

editor_note: Nothing here would mislead a learner. Core terms are consistent: atenuare a erorilor, straturi, cutii adnotate/încadrate, primitivă, Estimator client-side/server-side. In [37], the source's generic "the learner" becomes the class name "NoiseLearner". Step 2's layers come from the client-side Estimator's find_unique_layers, so the learner is really NoiseLearnerV3, and naming the legacy class adds something the source does not say. There are also two small wording issues: [10] says "vechi este învechit (scos din uz)", which is repetitive, and "helper" is translated as "program auxiliar" in [0] but "Asistent" in [44].

examples.source: The noise maps returned by the learner are positionally matched to those layers
examples.translation: Hărțile de zgomot returnate de NoiseLearner corespund pozițional acelor straturi
examples.suggested: Hărțile de zgomot returnate de learner (instrumentul de învățare a zgomotului) corespund pozițional acelor straturi
examples.why: The source says the generic 'learner'. In the step-2 context (find_unique_layers on the client-side Estimator) that means NoiseLearnerV3. Naming the legacy class NoiseLearner adds a specific claim that is not in the source.

examples.source: The legacy server-side Estimator is deprecated
examples.translation: `Estimator` server-side vechi este învechit (scos din uz)
examples.suggested: `Estimator` server-side vechi este depreciat
examples.why: 'vechi ... învechit (scos din uz)' repeats itself and the parenthetical gloss is clumsy. A native technical writer would just write 'depreciat' or 'scos din uz'.

examples.source: Noise learning helper
examples.translation: Asistent de învățare a zgomotului
examples.suggested: Program auxiliar pentru învățarea zgomotului
examples.why: 'helper' is translated as 'program auxiliar' in [0] but 'Asistent' here. 'Asistent' also sounds like an interactive assistant rather than a helper program.

editor_note: The translation is faithful and reads naturally in the informal "tu" register. "QPU consumption" becomes "Timpul cuantic pe care îl consumă un job", and the source's claim that lower precision needs more shots is kept as written. The NoiseLearner caveat ("un model de zgomot devine depășit după un anumit timp") is preserved intact.

The meaning is accurate throughout, and nothing would mislead a learner. The In progress/RUNNING vs. usage explanation in [17]-[21] and the session-mode caveat in [23] are carried over correctly. The problems are small grammar and style slips in [16]. "pe care te aștepți să dureze" is a wrong relative construction (should be "despre care te aștepți să dureze"), and "numit `RUNNING`" should agree with "starea" as "numită". "Contenție QPU" in [19]-[20] is a calque; "concurență pentru QPU" would sound more natural. Terms such as job-uri and sarcini de lucru (for workloads) are used consistently.

examples.source: a job ... you expect to take only a few seconds stays in the **In progress** status (called `RUNNING` in Qiskit)
examples.translation: un job ... pe care te aștepți să dureze doar câteva secunde rămâne în starea **In progress** (numit `RUNNING` în Qiskit)
examples.suggested: un job ... despre care te aștepți să dureze doar câteva secunde rămâne în starea **In progress** (numită `RUNNING` în Qiskit)
examples.why: The relative clause is ungrammatical ("pe care te aștepți să dureze"), and the participle does not agree with the feminine noun "starea".

examples.source: This is known as *QPU contention*. When contention is high
examples.translation: Acest lucru este cunoscut ca *contenție QPU*. Când contenția este ridicată
examples.suggested: Acest fenomen se numește *concurență pentru QPU* (QPU contention). Când concurența este ridicată
examples.why: "Contenție" is an anglicism that is rare in Romanian technical writing. "Concurență pentru resursă" is the usual term, and keeping the English in parentheses would still help the reader.

editor_note: The meaning is faithful throughout. Nothing would mislead a learner: the NoiseLearner/EstimatorV2 vs NoiseLearnerV3/Executor compatibility note, the InjectNoise ref/modifier_ref explanation and the dictionary-mapping step all match the English. There are some wording problems. "Helper program" is calqued as "programul ajutor", and the page title "Ajutor pentru învățarea zgomotului" reads like a help page rather than the name of a helper tool; "programul auxiliar" would fit better. In [26], "set de instrucțiuni în cutie de la intrare" is stiff. [33] drops the dative article in "transmis Executor", then uses "Executor-ului" in the next sentence. [30] has the calque "pentru specificarea unde să se injecteze zgomotul".

examples.source: Noise learning helper
examples.translation: Ajutor pentru învățarea zgomotului
examples.suggested: Programul auxiliar pentru învățarea zgomotului
examples.why: 'Ajutor' as a bare title reads as 'Help', not a helper tool; the same calque 'programul ajutor' recurs in [0], [11], [25] and [36].

examples.source: one for each input-boxed set of instructions
examples.translation: câte unul pentru fiecare set de instrucțiuni în cutie de la intrare
examples.suggested: câte unul pentru fiecare set de instrucțiuni încapsulat într-o cutie la intrare
examples.why: Word-by-word rendering that reads stiffly and is hard to parse.

examples.source: before being passed to Executor
examples.translation: înainte de a fi transmis Executor
examples.suggested: înainte de a fi transmis Executor-ului
examples.why: The dative article is missing, which is ungrammatical. The next sentence and [34] use 'Executor-ului'.

examples.source: the annotation for specifying where to inject noise
examples.translation: adnotarea pentru specificarea unde să se injecteze zgomotul
examples.suggested: adnotarea care specifică unde se injectează zgomotul
examples.why: This calques English syntax. 'specificarea unde' is not idiomatic Romanian.

editor_note: The translation is faithful and reads naturally, uses informal "tu" throughout ("Alăturându-te", "Fie că ești"), and renders the terms correctly ("deschiderea codului-sursă", "stivei de software cuantic", "framework versatil de calcul cuantic", "pull request-uri").

The meaning is faithful all the way through. Every claim, number and caveat survives: the noise degradation at 90 and 100 qubits in [21], the disclaimer in [18], the single QAOA round and CPU grid search in [15] and [28], and the binary-to-spin example in [51]. Nothing would mislead a learner. A native editor would still fix a few calques. In [57], "probleme QUBO rare și dense" can be read as "uncommon QUBO problems". In [8], "abstractizarea informației cuantice de la qubiții fizici" is a literal copy of the English. In [14], "care este transpilat într-un ansatz logic care corespunde" stacks two relative clauses. Terminology is consistent throughout: "hamiltonian", "stare fundamentală", "porți cu doi qubiți", "adâncimea circuitului", "backend", "shot-uri".

examples.source: Solve sparse and dense QUBO problems
examples.translation: Rezolvă probleme QUBO rare și dense
examples.suggested: Rezolvă probleme QUBO cu structură rară (sparse) sau densă
examples.why: 'probleme ... rare' most naturally reads as 'uncommon problems'. 'rar' only means sparse when it is attached to a matrix or structure.

examples.source: By abstracting quantum information away from the physical qubits
examples.translation: Prin abstractizarea informației cuantice de la qubiții fizici
examples.suggested: Prin decuplarea informației cuantice de qubiții fizici
examples.why: This copies 'abstract away from' word for word. 'abstractizarea ... de la' is not idiomatic Romanian.

examples.source: which is transpiled to a logical ansatz matching the native gate set
examples.translation: care este transpilat într-un ansatz logic care corespunde setului nativ de porți
examples.suggested: care este transpilat într-un ansatz logic adaptat setului nativ de porți
examples.why: The two stacked 'care' clauses make the sentence stiff.

editor_note: The meaning holds throughout. The broadcasting rules, the zip/outer examples (5x1, 1x6 x 4x1 -> 4x6) and the BitArray axis description all match the source. Three things a native editor would still fix. In [18], "nu trebuie să aibă" can be read as a prohibition ("must not"); "nu este necesar să aibă" is clearer. "Observable" appears as a masculine singular ("un singur observabil", [10] and [29]) next to the conventional feminine plural "observabile care comută... acestea". The plural of PUB is spelled two ways: "PUBuri" in [6]-[7] and "PUB-uri" everywhere else.

examples.source: Input arrays do not need to have the same number of dimensions.
examples.translation: Array-urile de intrare nu trebuie să aibă același număr de dimensiuni.
examples.suggested: Nu este necesar ca array-urile de intrare să aibă același număr de dimensiuni.
examples.why: In Romanian, 'nu trebuie să' is often read as 'must not', which could make a permissive rule sound like a prohibition. The context rescues it, but the wording is ambiguous.

examples.source: (broadcast single observable)
examples.translation: (broadcasting al unui singur observabil)
examples.suggested: (broadcasting al unei singure observabile)
examples.why: 'Observabilă' is feminine in Romanian physics usage, and the rest of the file treats it that way ('observabile care comută... acestea'). The same masculine slip appears in [10] ('un singur observabil').

examples.source: These PUBs are the fundamental unit of work
examples.translation: Aceste PUBuri sunt unitatea fundamentală de lucru
examples.suggested: Aceste PUB-uri sunt unitatea fundamentală de lucru
examples.why: The plural is spelled 'PUBuri' here and in [7], but 'PUB-uri' everywhere else in the file. The hyphenated form is the correct way to inflect an acronym.

editor_note: Faithful and native: the deprecation timeline in [3] ("depreciat... va fi eliminat la începutul anului 2025", SDK v1.3.0/v2.0.0) is kept exactly, and pulse schedule→"planificări de puls" and fractional gates→"porți fracționare" are used consistently throughout.

The meaning is faithful all the way through, including the numbers (30 vs 170.000 shots, the 10.000-shot assumption, the qubit thresholds) and the caveat about classical processing time. Nothing here would mislead a learner. There are some small editorial slips. 'Expectation value' is rendered two ways: 'valoarea așteptată' in [28]-[29] and 'valoarea de așteptare' in [35]. The heading in [55], 'Obțineți asistență', breaks the informal 'tu' register. 'Counts' is calqued as 'numărători' in [49]-[50], and [61] keeps the English possessive in 'cu Q-CTRL's Performance Management'.

examples.source: determine the expectation value of a single circuit-observable pair
examples.translation: determina valoarea de așteptare a unei perechi circuit-observabil
examples.suggested: determina valoarea așteptată a unei perechi circuit-observabil
examples.why: Entry [28] uses 'valoarea așteptată'. Using two renderings in one file is inconsistent, and 'valoare de așteptare' is not the usual term.

examples.source: Get support
examples.translation: Obțineți asistență
examples.suggested: Obține asistență
examples.why: This is a formal plural imperative. The rest of the page addresses the reader with 'tu' (contactează, consultă).

examples.source: Plot the bitstring with the highest counts to see if the hidden bitstring was the mode.
examples.translation: Reprezintă grafic șirul de biți cu cele mai multe numărători pentru a vedea dacă șirul de biți ascuns a fost modul.
examples.suggested: Reprezintă grafic șirul de biți cu cele mai multe apariții pentru a vedea dacă șirul de biți ascuns a fost cel mai frecvent (modul).
examples.why: 'Numărători' is a stiff calque of 'counts'. On its own, 'modul' is ambiguous in Romanian; it can be read as 'the modulus' or 'the way'.

examples.source: Transverse-Field Ising Model with Q-CTRL's Performance Management
examples.translation: Modelul Ising cu câmp transversal cu Q-CTRL's Performance Management
examples.suggested: Modelul Ising cu câmp transversal cu Performance Management de la Q-CTRL
examples.why: The English possessive 's is left inside a Romanian sentence. Entry [25] already uses the natural form 'Performance Management de la Q-CTRL'.

editor_note: The meaning is faithful throughout, including the notes, so nothing here would mislead a learner. The support caveats in notes 4 to 9 (parsing versus export versus hardware execution, nested control flow not eligible, `input` variables) keep their negations and qualifiers intact. Entry [13] adds "(din coloana Notes)", which is not in the source. The addition is accurate and harmless, but it is an interpolation, and it points to the English column header "Notes" while the section heading is translated as "Note". In entry [24], "va evalua cu anticipare" is a stiff calque of "eagerly evaluate"; "va evalua imediat" reads more naturally to a native technical reader.

examples.source: The meaning of "partial support" typically depends on the linked notes.
examples.translation: Semnificația „suportului parțial" depinde de obicei de notele asociate (din coloana Notes).
examples.suggested: Semnificația „suportului parțial" depinde de obicei de notele asociate.
examples.why: The parenthetical is not in the English. It is accurate, but it is an unrequested interpolation that names the untranslated column header.

examples.source: will eagerly evaluate gate modifiers during the parse
examples.translation: va evalua cu anticipare modificatorii de poartă în timpul parsării
examples.suggested: va evalua imediat modificatorii de poartă în timpul parsării
examples.why: "Cu anticipare" is a literal calque of "eagerly". A native technical writer would say "imediat" or "direct" to mean that the evaluation happens up front.

editor_note: Nothing in the file would mislead a learner. The V1-to-V2 primitives passages, the shots/precision passage and the removals under providers/pulse all say what the English says. The fixes are small. In [222], "it" (the Quaternion class) became "modulul", so the sentence now says a module can't be reached. "Legacy" is calqued as "pachetul moștenire" / "redirecționare moștenire" ([233], [236], [239]). "Expectation values" is the calque "valorilor de așteptare" rather than "valorilor așteptate/medii" ([100]). The same section heading appears three different ways ([170], [171], [191]), and "path" slips in untranslated in [133] where every other entry uses "cale".

examples.suggested: pentru estimările valorilor așteptate
